disconnectBody: Bagel stops posting and forgets which server this channel is linked to. Your channels and roles stay exactly as they are. Bagel itself stays in the server. To remove it, right-click Bagel in the server's member list in Discord and choose Kick.
setupFirstRun: This server has no saved settings yet. Applying the template saves them.
templateHelp: The server template is optional. Bagel can add its own roles and channels to this server. Nothing in your server changes until you apply it.
planComplete: This server already has everything the template needs. Nothing to apply.
applyBody: Roles to create: {roles}. Channels to create: {channels}. Nothing is deleted or renamed.
